scientific_limitations_and_integrity.domain: Balanced complete bipartite graphs of order 2m with m>=3, one designated priced perfect matching, positive prices, arbitrary nonnegative individual edge weights with a connected resulting graph, real spectral orders p>=0.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: Analytic proof is primary evidence. Standalone finite numerical/exact-rational checks are reproducibility aids, not infinite proof. No independent audit was performed. Related unindexed results remain a priority risk.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proved: An exact order-dependent matching deletion threshold, global uniqueness for every finite order, strict monotonicity across all real orders, two large-network scaling regimes and a noncommuting pair of limits.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.unproved: No classification for other topologies or heterogeneous prices; no joint asymptotic formula for the optimal conductance ratio when order grows with network size; no unique spectral-gap optimizer claim.

title: Spectral-moment price hierarchy on matching-priced balanced bipartite networks
